name: Mux8-1
fullname: 8 to 1 selector, by a knob and a level
summary: Eight to one selector, by a knob and a level (the G2's Sw8-1 inside).
author: Animatek
about: Chooses one of eight inputs and sends it to the output. The input picked is the Sel knob plus the level at Ctrl, in steps of eight units, held to 1-8. It is the G2's Mux8-1 and Sw8-1 in one module, because the G1 has few free types.
With Ctrl unplugged, the knob picks the input (the Sw8-1). With Sel on 1, a level at Ctrl picks it (the Mux8-1). Eight LEDs show which one is on.
usage: Plug eight sources into In 1-8 and turn Sel to switch between them.
Send a stepped control signal (a sequencer or a counter's output) to Ctrl to switch under automation.
notes: Control rate, for levels and gates. Audio through it would be at the control rate.
